record.reason: Primary abstract: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has significantly increased GPU memory pressure, which is further aggravated by training optimization techniques such as virtual pipeline and recomputation that disrupt tensor lifespans and introduce considerable memory fragmentation.
record.title: Reducing GPU Memory Fragmentation via Spatio-Temporal Planning for Efficient Large-Scale Model Training
